layout: Meralco residential statement (My Meralco PDF, 2026 layout), 2 pages
about: What the app reads from an uploaded Meralco PDF (www/lib/parse.js) and the arithmetic the bill itself must satisfy (www/lib/checks.js). Every formula uses only numbers printed on the bill. Run on a file: node scripts/validate_bill.mjs <bill.pdf>.

fields.label: Ave. daily consumption this bill period
Ave. daily cost this bill period
This bill is N% higher/lower (+/-X kWh) vs previous billing period
This bill is N% higher/lower (+/-X kWh) vs same period last year

summary.label: Bill Computation Summary
summary.note: One amount per group below, plus "Applied Credits" when the bill has credits. They add up to Charges for this billing period.

tracker.label: Your monthly consumption
tracker.this_year: upper row of 12 cells, Jan..Dec, '-' for months not billed yet
tracker.note: The lower row's cell for the bill's own month is not reliable (seen holding 0, or this year's value). The parser sets last year's same month to kwh - vs_last_year_kwh.

lines.label: ENERGY TAX / FIRST
lines.base: kwh - 650 (first 650 kWh exempt); seen on bills of 706 to 857 kWh, brackets above 1,000 kWh not seen yet

lines.label: VALUE ADDED TAX: Power Act Reduction
VALUE ADDED TAX: Ancillary Service Charge
VALUE ADDED TAX: System Loss Charge

group_fields: For each group: its amount on page 1 (Bill Computation Summary) and, on page 2 (How your bill was computed), its amount and percent. For each line: base (kWh, months or pesos), price (rate or percent) and amount. A line the spec does not list is still read and still counted in its group's sum.

credits.label: Applied Credits
credits.note: Printed after Total Energy Amount when credits were applied (bill deposit refunds, interest refunds), followed by one line per credit.

checks.name: readings
checks.formula: (current_reading - previous_reading) x multiplier = kwh

checks.name: tracker_latest
checks.formula: this year's last tracker cell = kwh

checks.name: line_sum
checks.formula: page 1 summary amounts add up to charges_this_period

checks.name: total
checks.formula: remaining_balance + charges_this_period + installment_due = total_amount_due

checks.name: line_amounts
checks.formula: every line with a base and a price: base x price = amount (percent lines: base x price / 100)

checks.name: kwh_bases
checks.formula: every per-kWh line is billed on the same kWh as Actual Consumption

checks.name: percent_bases
checks.formula: each VAT line is charged on the amount of the group or line it taxes

checks.name: lft_base
checks.formula: LFT base = VAT Sales base + RPT + RPT Adj.

checks.name: energy_tax_base
checks.formula: energy tax is charged on kWh above 650

checks.name: group_sums
checks.formula: the lines of each group add up to the group's amount

checks.name: summary_matches_detail
checks.formula: each group's amount on page 1 = its amount on page 2

checks.name: group_percents
checks.formula: group amount / Total Energy Amount = the printed percent

checks.name: vat_sales_base
checks.formula: Generation + Transmission + System Loss + Distribution + Senior Citizen = VAT Sales base

checks.name: vat_total
checks.formula: the VALUE ADDED TAX lines add up to VAT Sales VAT

checks.name: non_vat
checks.formula: other taxes + Universal + FiT-All + GEA-All + Lifeline = Non-VAT

checks.name: total_energy_amount
checks.formula: VAT Sales base + VAT + VAT Zero Rated + Non-VAT = Total Energy Amount = sum of the groups

checks.name: credits
checks.formula: the credit lines add up to Applied Credits

checks.name: charges_total
checks.formula: Total Energy Amount + Applied Credits = Charges for this billing period

checks.name: rate_this_month
checks.formula: Total Energy Amount / kWh = Your rate this month

checks.name: vs_previous
checks.formula: kWh - last month's kWh = the printed change vs previous billing period

checks.name: vs_last_year_pct
checks.formula: change vs last year / last year's kWh = the printed percent

checks.name: avg_daily
checks.formula: kWh / days = average daily consumption; Total Energy Amount / days = average daily cost

checks.name: ghg
checks.formula: kWh x 0.0006935 = Equiv. GHG Emissions

derived.formula: sum of What you've paid rows whose billing period ends the day before period_start (payments, so not always the full bill)
